author: SpicyAF
body:
We basically only need people who can do the most of the following:

1. Ninja Bridge/Ninja Stair

2. Good with bow or PvP

3. Can defend

4. Is fine with any position

5. Speaks (fluent) english

If you can do most of these, please join our team!
